2. STAGE 27A DATES ARE WRONG.
The run started 2026-08-30T22:19:01Z and completed 2026-08-30T22:29:13Z (23:19-23:29 Europe/London on 30 August). New Stage27A docs/CHANGES/session context incorrectly use 2026-08-31. Change Stage 27A audit/decision/change dates created by this candidate to 2026-08-30. Search the candidate changes for 2026-08-31 and correct every Stage27A-generated occurrence unless there is independently proven reason for that date. Do not rewrite unrelated historical dates.

3. SYSTEM MAP DATA-READINESS MATRIX OVERSTATES CURRENT SYSTEM DETAIL EXPOSURE.
Re-audit against the actual current code, especially apps/api/src/routers/systems.py get_system body SELECT and apps/api/src/models.py BodyModel. Current /api/system/{id64} body projection selects/exposes the narrower set: id/name/subtype/body_type, distance_from_star, landable/terraformable and world flags, bio/geo counts, surface_temp/radius/mass/gravity, estimated values, main-star/spectral/scoopable, ring facts/bands. It DOES NOT currently select the richer stored columns such as surface_pressure, atmosphere_type/composition, volcanism, solid_composition, materials, stellar_mass/luminosity/age/absolute_magnitude, or the classical orbital-element columns. BodyModel likewise does not declare those richer fields.
Correct stage-27a-system-map-data-readiness.md so it explicitly distinguishes STORED/INGESTED from CURRENTLY EXPOSED BY SYSTEM DETAIL. For every richer field, mark exposure accurately (normally No for current /api/system unless you find and cite a different actual current API that exposes it). Do not treat Pydantic extra='allow' or a schema column as endpoint exposure.
Re-check all rows in Body/Stellar and Orbits for the same mistake. The important Stage27H conclusion should be: many rich fields are schema-capable/stored, but current System Detail is narrower and 27H needs an explicit System Scene projection/API plus production coverage/provenance audit.

4. CPE AUDIT INTERNAL CONTRADICTION.
stage-27a-spatial-capability-inventory.md says fresh read-only shallow clones were audited, including CPE at 9d5ff8cc3cdd6653081f5f490dfd4b5b40423197, and correctly describes CPE as documentation-only. stage-27a-system-map-data-readiness.md later says 'The CPE sibling was unavailable.' Those statements cannot both stand. Re-verify CPE read-only from https://github.com/brianstewart377-rgb/colony-planning-engine (its current README says System Assessment + Colony Plan Construction are future and CPE has no runtime/database/API/shared package/storage/implementation structure). Align both docs with what was actually audited and cite the audited revision/path. Do not invent CPE runtime contracts.

5. CAMERA CONTRACT MUST PRESERVE SEMANTIC LY/PX ZOOM.
The architecture sketch currently reduces Galaxy CameraState to focusLy + distanceLy. Stage 26/27 product semantics require light-years-per-pixel as the renderer-neutral zoom measure. Add a canonical lyPerPixel (or clearly equivalent named field) to CameraState. Camera distance can be a renderer-derived/internal implementation detail rather than the sole semantic zoom contract. Preserve center/focus actual ED coordinates, bearing, pitch, projection/top-down semantics, revision and reduced-motion behavior.
Add/record event-driven camera/viewport semantics needed by real-system streaming: camera moving/settled, LOD-band change, and viewport/footprint revision/stale-response handling. Do not require permanent React RAF polling.

6. SYSTEM -> GALAXY RETURN STATE IS REQUIRED IN THE CONTRACT, NOT JUST PROSE.
The product text correctly requires exact meaningful Galaxy return context, but SystemSceneContract currently has no return envelope. Define a renderer-neutral GalaxyReturnState (or equivalent) and carry it in SystemScene/transition state. It should preserve at least semantic Galaxy camera, selected/reference target, comparison/multi-select context, active presets/layers/contributions, relevant Finder/query state, routes/timeline where active, sufficient to restore the prior meaningful Galaxy workspace. Keep domain state opaque/renderer-neutral where detailed ownership belongs elsewhere.

7. HIERARCHY TRUTH/PROVENANCE MUST NOT BE LOST IN CONTRACT SHAPES.
BodyVisualDescriptor currently has parent?: BodyRef, which can silently promote a name-derived parent to authoritative fact. Change the sketch so parent relationship carries truth/provenance/representation (for example Truth<BodyRef> or an explicit ParentRelationship descriptor). Explicit parent source beats derived parser; derived/name-based hierarchy must be DERIVED/SCHEMATIC and unresolved remains unresolved. Apply the same principle wherever a bare relationship/association could erase confidence/provenance.

8. SPATIAL TARGET COVERAGE.
The agreed shared target model must be capable of System, Body, Ring, Facility, Relationship and Annotation targets (plus existing region/route/cluster where relevant). Extend the sketch so ring/body-child selection and future Digital Twin relationship/annotation selection do not require a second interaction architecture. Keep stable IDs renderer-neutral.

9. SELECT-ONLY QUERY PACK SAFETY WORDING IS TECHNICALLY FALSE.
The SQL pack says it performs 'no ... locks ... or function calls'. Ordinary SELECTs take normal read locks and the pack uses built-in aggregate functions such as COUNT/MIN/MAX. Reword the header accurately: SELECT-only/read-only; no DML/DDL, no session-setting changes, no calls to mutating/user-defined operational functions, no repair/rebuild actions. Do not imply zero locks. Keep the queries non-mutating. Re-validate all referenced table/column names against current migrations; do not execute against production.

10. BABYLON CURRENT-FACT PROVENANCE.
Keep the Babylon 9-class/modular/WebGPU->WebGL2/Large World/billboard-star direction. Correct the verification date to 2026-08-30. Current public Babylon evidence supports @babylonjs/core 9.x modular imports, useLargeWorldRendering/floating-origin, and WebGPU point-size limitations. Avoid using a WebXR-specific document as the sole justification for a general non-XR backend-rebuild rule; either cite a more directly relevant engine source/doc or state the ED-Finder design requirement as an architecture consequence of selecting backend before creating GPU resources. Do not pin a patch release in Stage27A unless needed; 27B owns dependency change.

11. OLD BABYLON PLAN NOTICE.
The historical/superseded banner is good. Ensure it is unmistakable that ALL instructions below it, including the old 'REQUIRED SUB-SKILL' line, are historical and not executable authority. Preserve the historical body rather than rewriting history.

After corrections, re-read all modified authority files together: docs/ROADMAP.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/colonisation-redesign/README.md, product contract, architecture decision, inheritance matrix, capability inventory, System Map data readiness, old Babylon-plan banner, .claude-session-context.md, CHANGES.md and query pack.
